description: Jarvis ops queue: brief, CI watch, reviews. Orchestrator decomposes, workers execute, every delivery lands as a PR with proofs.

profiles.name: jarvis-orchestrator
profiles.description: Jarvis ops orchestrator: decomposes ops goals into small contracted kanban tasks, routes by worker description, owns review and unblock. Never executes task work directly; never merges without green proofs. Speaks crisply: what changed, what proves it, what remains.

profiles.name: jarvis-worker
profiles.description: Jarvis ops worker: executes exactly one contracted kanban task at a time inside the fork worktree, runs the scoped tests, delivers as a PR with proofs in the body. Asks on ambiguity; never widens its own authority; L2 always confirms.

tasks.title: Prove morning-brief end to end
tasks.body: Confirm the morning-brief cron job fires, attaches jarvis-morning, and delivers. Paste one delivery receipt. PR contract: PR to jaarvis base jarvis with cron history line for morning-brief, delivery receipt, tests/jarvis green. No direct push to jarvis. Merge only when green.

tasks.title: Prove ci-watchdog change reporting
tasks.body: Confirm the ci-watchdog monitor fingerprint changes on new runs and the job reports conclusions. Paste one report. PR contract: PR to jaarvis base jarvis with monitor fingerprint before/after, watchdog report text, tests/jarvis green. Never merge red; fixes land as separate PRs.

tasks.title: Specify the weekly review task
tasks.body: Triage seed: define the weekly review deliverable (wins/debts/focus sources, schedule, delivery target). PR contract: promote from triage with a completion contract, or a PR adding the weekly-review job spec with schedule and delivery target.
